cauliflower.why: compound noun+noun; head element pluralizes. Priberam: 'couves-flor ou couves-flores'

leek.why: compound; head noun pluralizes. Priberam Plural: alhos-porós

pretzel.why: English loan; builder misapplied -l->-éis. Priberam Plural: pretzels

snorkel.why: English loan; builder misapplied -l->-éis. Priberam Plural: snorkels

closet.why: plural did not even match singular 'Closet'. Priberam Plural: closets

rainbow.why: was invariant (p===s); compound head pluralizes. Priberam Plural: arcos-íris

phlox.why: 'Floxs' is impossible in pt; nouns ending in -x are invariable (tórax/ônix). Priberam headword 'flox' shows no distinct plural

kettlebell.why: 'Kettlebelis' is a builder artifact; English loan takes +s like all Priberam-attested sibling loans (bagel->bagels, snorkel->snorkels, pretzel->pretzels)

map.why: 'mapa' is masculine (o mapa). Priberam: nome masculino

stairs.why: 'escada' is feminine (a escada). Priberam: nome feminino

pickup-truck.why: 'picape' is feminine in BR (a picape). Priberam: nome feminino

van.why: 'van' is feminine (a van). Priberam: nome feminino, Plural: vans
